components.notes: Official card lists CC BY 4.0 and 102 languages including Shona (sn), Luo/Dholuo (luo_ke), and Swahili (sw_ke) configs. FLEURS is sentence-read speech, not a beginner course; still needs native review before publication and exact per-clip alignment verification against source keys.
Transcripts distributed alongside audio under the same CC BY 4.0 terms.
FLEURS is monolingual sentence-read speech; no editorially reviewed translation is supplied by the source. Root must author/verify any translation separately before publication.

Dataverse metadata (latest version 9.1) declares CC BY 4.0 with 4,837 listed files across mixed text/speech content. The dataset-level language field currently reads Swahili despite the broader Dholuo/Swahili/Luhya description; per-file metadata and manual review govern which files are actually usable, not that field alone.
Speech files exist in the release but text/audio alignment must be verified per file before any component is marked cleared; unclear alignment is quarantined, not assumed.

Update releaseId/license once a real authorized release is available.

Only validated.tsv clips (not reported.tsv) may ever be considered; contributor demographic fields are excluded from any app artifact. Requires an authorized local archive/documented download; adapter must not bypass access restrictions.
Sentence and direct link exports are CC BY 2.0 FR by default per Tatoeba's downloads/terms pages; a CC0 subset may exist for specific sentences and must be checked per-sentence, not assumed globally.
Direct links (links.csv equivalent) express sentence-to-translation pairs; translation rights follow the same CC BY 2.0 FR default as sentences.

Audio license is contributor-selected per recording and is NOT covered by the text/translation CC BY 2.0 FR default. Each audio file's license must be resolved individually; unresolved or incompatible audio terms are rejected, not imported.
